Brand launch · Customer experience

₹5 crore in the first year.

A furniture brand launch shaped by architects and interior designers.

Role

Senior Manager, Marketing & Brand Strategy

Period

2012–2018

Scope

Brand strategy · Go-to-market · Product presentation · Sales and service

01

Executive Summary

I led go-to-market planning from product concept through rollout. Feedback from architects and interior designers shaped the positioning. I trained the sales team and coordinated production and delivery readiness. The brand exceeded its acquisition target within 90 days and generated ₹5 crore in first-year revenue.

02

The Challenge

Carry the brand promise consistently into launch communications, product presentation and the customer-facing experience. The campaign and the experience customers received needed to support the same positioning.

03

The Execution

  1. Set the launch direction

    Worked with Engineering, Sales and Communications to coordinate the brand launch.

  2. Bring the brand to market

    Developed integrated marketing across digital, print, events and PR.

  3. Make the product tangible

    Connected product stories, materials and finish options with customer consideration.

  4. Carry the promise through

    Coordinated go-to-market activity with procurement, sales, customer service and daily operations.

04
